systemStatus.detail:
TUE AUG 25, 7:10 AM PT RUN. This is the first run since Sunday Aug 23 -- the Monday run did not happen, so everything below covers a two-day catch-up.

1. PAYROLL -- DUE TODAY. Default Payroll BIWEEKLY, Aug 9 - Aug 22, due Tue Aug 25, pay date Fri Aug 28, estimated $28,571.32. Toast lists 2 action items and 2 insights. Action items: UNAPPROVED TIP POOLS covering 13 days, and AUTO-CLOCKOUTS on 4 employees. Insights: 9 employees with no timesheets, 25 employees with no direct deposit. The 13-day unapproved tip window covers Aug 9-22, which means Saturday Aug 22 -- the $16.7k record service -- has an unapproved tip pool sitting in it. Order of operations: approve tip pools, clear the 4 auto-clockouts, chase the 9 missing timesheets, then fund. The 25-employee no-direct-deposit figure is a standing operational drag, not a today problem, but it is worth a separate push.

2. URGENT, DAY 18 -- FOOD SAFETY ALLEGATION STILL LIVE ON GOOGLE. Donald Clay, 1 star, on The Brewhouse listing: a public claim of botulism from a taco. Unanswered on four consecutive runs, now on a 528-review profile. Same guidance as before and it has not changed: pull the Aug 7 lunch prep, hold and cooling logs for the taco station BEFORE anyone types a word, then post a short non-defensive reply that moves it offline. A draft is staged in reviews.unanswered[]. Do not argue the medical claim in public and do not delete anything.

3. TOAST -- THREE DAYS, ONE RECORD AND TWO BAD ONES.
   SATURDAY AUG 22 (full detail, backfilled): net $16,721.45, gross $16,946.75, 278 guests, 181 orders, 190 checks. Net is +99.2% vs Saturday Aug 15 and +86.0% vs the 4-Saturday average -- achieved on 8.9% FEWER guests and 11.3% FEWER orders. Avg check $88.01 against $38.68 SDLW. Dining Room did $13,588.70 net (81.2% of the day) at $123.53 per order; Liquor $4,425 on 289 items and Bottled Beer $2,011 on 329 items. Every signal says large private party or buyout, not organic demand. Confirm what it was before it goes into any forecast. Labor read 13.3% of net only because the denominator doubled -- the roster was a normal 13 people / 82.25 hrs. One flag: voids $259.50 across 16 orders, +241% vs SDLW.
   SUNDAY AUG 23 (full detail, backfilled): net $4,564.12, -22.3% SDLW and -33.9% vs the 4-Sunday average. LABOR 39.8% OF NET, the worst number in this file, against 25.1% SDLW and 21.4% on the 4-week average. Labor dollars rose 23% to $1,817.51 while sales fell 22%. The roster was 11 employees / 13 shifts / 55.50 hrs with 5.25 OT. Guests 202, orders 144, avg check $30.63. Voids and discounts were both well BELOW average, so this is purely a demand-versus-staffing miss.
   MONDAY AUG 24 (PARTIAL -- group email only): net $2,879.70, gross $2,961.40, 133 guests, 108 orders, avg $26.66 per order. Labor 28.8% of net, second straight day over target. Monday's roster was already small at 6 employees / 25.50 hrs with zero OT, so 28.8% on a $2.9k day is the fixed cost of opening, not overstaffing. The single-location email with SDLW and category detail lands ~7:40 AM, after this run.
   READ ACROSS THE THREE DAYS: one enormous event Saturday masked a genuinely soft weekend underneath it. Strip Saturday out and Sun+Mon combined is $7,443.82 across two days.

4. SLING -- TODAY IS LIVE, AND THE SCHEDULE IS BEING CUT. Tue Aug 25: 8 employees, 8 shifts, 37.66 hours, 0 uncovered, 0 overtime, 0 off. Roster: Isael Salvador Narciso (Cook), Julianna Ornelas and Maggie Burt (Baristas), Tony Rincon and Andrew Turner (Bartenders), Christine Vargas, Augustine Arroyo and Bri Kelley (Servers). Four-day trend: Sat 13 emp / 82.25 hrs / 5.25 OT, Sun 11 emp / 55.50 hrs / 5.25 OT, Mon 6 emp / 25.50 hrs / 0 OT, Tue 8 emp / 37.66 hrs / 0 OT. Overtime has been driven to zero, which is the right response to Sunday's 39.8%. The exposure is ONE COOK with no kitchen redundancy.

5. GOOGLE ADS -- LIVE SCRAPE, account 343-687-4835. Yesterday Aug 24: 207 impressions, 10 clicks, 4.83% CTR, $5.71 spend, ~$0.57 avg CPC, 0 conversions on the day. Only 'BHC Coffee | Search | P1 Launch' is Eligible; it is spending $5.71 against a $15/day budget, so the account is underspending. Last 7 days (Aug 18-24): 2,522 impressions, 112 clicks, $122.79, 33.00 conversions -- and conversions have finally stopped 'calculating': 29.00 of those came from the coffee search campaign at $3.28 each. 'Local store visits and promotions-Performance Max-2', the MAIN RESTAURANT CAMPAIGN, is CONFIRMED STILL PAUSED -- DAY 8 DARK -- yet it still logged 884 impressions, 27 clicks and 4.00 conversions (~$6.94 each) inside the 7-day window before it stopped. That is the single biggest fixable item in the ad account. 'Oldest SB Brewery on Tap' and 'World Cup HQ 2026' remain paused. Google is recommending a target CPA on the coffee campaign. Separately, Toast sent two 'Ready to bring diners with Google Ads?' emails Aug 24 claiming no active campaigns -- that is Toast's own managed-ads product, not this account. Do not double-buy.

6. YELP -- LIVE SCRAPE, and one real change. AUDIENCE SIZE HAS DROPPED FROM 'IDEAL' TO 'LIMITED', with Yelp's own warning that control features can limit how often the ad shows and raise cost-per-click. The metrics agree: ad impressions 40.3k -> 38.9k, ad share 79% -> 78%, page visits from ads 440 -> 430, avg CPC $1.07 -> $1.11. On the other side, leads from ads rose 100 -> 108 and cost-per-lead improved $3.94 -> $3.71. Billing period Aug 1-24: $322.72 spend, which is $13.45/day across the period -- essentially on budget at $13/day, though the last three days ran hotter at about $15.60/day. Trailing 12 months: 1,267 ad leads vs 729 organic (63% ad share), forecast 42. Action: open the targeting controls and loosen whatever tightened the audience. Listing sidebar shows 3.8 stars / 774 reviews, Reviews badge now 2, and the business INBOX STILL SHOWS 15 UNREAD, untouched since Aug 21.

7. GOOGLE REVIEWS -- QUEUE GREW AGAIN, 6 -> 8. The Brewhouse: 4.5 stars, 528 reviews (up 1), 6 unreplied, confirmed on screen as '1 of 6 reviews'. New arrival Justin Ladner, 5 stars, 2 days. Brewhouse Coffee: still a perfect 5.0, now 6 reviews (up 1), 2 unreplied -- new 5-star from Debra Wedlake ('Delicious coffee and pastries!') joins Geoff Lay, now 10 days out. Besides the Clay review and John Rinaldo's 31-day rating-only 1-star, the entire queue is FIVE 5-STAR REVIEWS GOING STALE. All eight replies are drafted and staged. Nothing posted -- Joal approves every reply.

8. RESERVATIONS. Today Tue Aug 25: ZERO on the books. Tomorrow Wed Aug 26: one confirmed 10-top -- Rich Davis, 7:00 PM, birthday dinner. Worth a pre-shift mention and a table plan, especially with one cook scheduled. Gail Gelber, 5 guests, 5:30 PM Sat Oct 10 still confirmed. TripAdvisor: no email in 72 hours, no action. Google Business Profile: 1 management request STILL PENDING at 39 days -- verify or deny it.
